{{Quote|If&hellip; if I could return. Oh, my Master&hellip; it has been&hellip; so long&hellip; and I regret so much&hellip;|[[Ajunta Pall]], after Revan convinced him to turn back to the light|<ref name="Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
This '''Jedi''' was a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] that served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. Their apprentice, [[Ajunta Pall]], fell to dark side and became the first [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]]. Eventually, the Jedi's apprentice was posthumously redeemed by Jedi Knight [[Revan/Legends|Revan]].

==Biography==
This individual began training in the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the era prior to the [[Second Great Schism]]. Studying on the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] library world of [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]], this Jedi eventually passed the [[Jedi Trials/Legends|Jedi Trials]] and was [[Knighting Ceremony/Legends|knighted]] by the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]]. Further pursuits of knowledge of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] and [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] skill earned this individual the rank of Master. It was at this point in life that this individual spotted [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|initiate]] [[Ajunta Pall]] and took him as a [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]]. Pall was trained to Knighthood.

Pall attained the rank of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] and began studying the ways of [[Sith alchemy/Legends|alchemy]]. Master Pall discovered the secret of creating and shaping life. Fearful of this power, the Order deemed it an abomination of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] and sought to erase all practice of it. [[Second Great Schism|The Jedi High Council forbid the teachings of Pall and his followers]], deeming him a pawn of the dark side of the Force.

Angered by this, Master Pall and his followers declared war on the Order, beginning a century-long conflict that would be known to history as the [[Hundred-Year Darkness/Legends|Hundred-Year Darkness]]. Obtaining significant power, the now [[High General]] Pall [[Death/Legends|slew]] more than a dozen Jedi during the [[Battle of Corbos|final battle of the war]] on [[Corbos]], but he and his fellow [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] were defeated nonetheless. Captured by his former comrades in the Jedi Order, Master Pall and his followers were stripped of their ranks and their weapons and [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|exiled]] from [[Realspace/Legends|space]] controlled by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

Pall resided in his [[Tomb of Ajunta Pall|tomb]] for years after he died, questioning his decision to go to war with the Jedi. Eventually, during the [[Jedi Civil War]], Jedi Padawan [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] came into the tomb. Revan convinced Pall to return to the [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light side]]. Just before disappearing, Pall mentioned his master.
